deliberate_trade_offs: Refuses to build an ATS, candidate database, resume parser, or outbound email sequencer — sits strictly in front of Bullhorn, Invenias, Crelate, Loxo, or spreadsheets as a per-job-order calibration and SLA gate so agencies adopt it on their next req with zero database migration.
